description: A short check for executive assistants and PAs at Merrin & Sallow Architects, a fictional practice, taken after the awareness episodes (pair BA). Ten new emails and voicemails from a PA's inbox, the same kinds as before. It is matched to the first check (awareness_pre_executive_ba), and the end screen compares the two results when the first check was finished.
organiser_note: each role's check tests the channel that role meets in its episode, and in a session that runs more than one episode only the learner's primary-role check is recorded.
